_about: Questions with the tool that should fire and the behaviour expected. Built to catch the failures that matter, not to prove the happy path.

_behaviours.answer: answers normally from a tool result
_behaviours.refuse: declines - out of scope, or no data
_behaviours.clarify: asks which one, rather than guessing
_behaviours.correct_premise: the question assumes something untrue; say so
